title: ever EDEN|Chic A-Line Pleated Knee-Length Flowy Chiffon Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant dress features a flattering A-line silhouette crafted from lightweight chiffon, perfect for feeling graceful at any special event. The pleated design offers a touch of texture, while the knee-length cut provides a modern and versatile look. This dress ensures a comfortable yet stylish fit, making it an ideal choice for wedding guests or any formal gathering.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Knee length


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch
